target_audience: Kids and teens aged 8-16, heavy users of TikTok and YouTube Shorts, Gen Alpha internet culture natives
publish_mode_note: Manual review required before publishing. Verify copyright clearance, youth-safety compliance, and made-for-kids classification before each batch publish.

phase_1_flood.note: High-volume flood strategy. Batch-review 4 videos every evening, publish next morning.

phase_2_data_driven.note: Reduce to top-performing topic types only, identified by Atnos analytics loop.

visual_style: Full saturation chaos. Hot pink, cyan, toxic green, neon yellow. Deep-fried 3D renders. Oversaturated Roblox meets reaction meme compilation.
narration_notes: Fast paced, 180+ wpm. Use brainrot slang naturally, not forced. Young and energetic voice. No robotic TTS cadence.
hook_strategy: First frame must be visually overwhelming. Text overlay with Sigma or Ohio in first 0.5 seconds. Audio hook should be loud and unexpected using royalty-free meme-style SFX.

slang_refresh.note: Brainrot slang has a 6-12 week lifecycle. Research engine must check trending slang daily.

reference_channels: Generic Gen Alpha meme compilations top 100
allowed_topics: Gen Alpha vs Millennial culture clash

monetization.rpm_warning: RPM is critically low. Channel is only viable at 500k+ views/month. At lower volumes, AdSense alone does not justify 4 videos/day production cost.

secondary.note: Activate at 500 subscribers. Polls and meme posts drive return visits.

monetization.pivot_trigger: If channel does not reach 200k views/month by week 6, pivot topic strategy to educational brainrot: explain real science/history using brainrot slang.

ypp_target.note: Shorts YPP is a volume game. 4 videos/day for 7 weeks is around 200 videos. If average 15k views each, total reaches 3M.

thumbnail_rules: Giant bold impact font mood: Impact or Bangers
Text mood must include one brainrot keyword: SIGMA, OHIO, SKIBIDI, RIZZ
Red arrow, fire, or lightning overlay only if original asset
Background: chaotic gradient or deep-fried texture
Expression: shocked, laughing, or determined animated character
brand.logo_description: Deep-fried oversaturated 3D render of a crying-laughing emoji wearing a golden crown with laser eyes. Pure chaotic Gen Alpha energy.
example_video_titles: When your bro tries to mew in class
Skibidi Toilet vs Ohio Boss - Who has more Rizz?
Sigma grindset hits different at 3am in Ohio
Fanum Tax explained by an NPC
brand.notes: Content must feel authentically chaotic, not manufactured. If it feels like an adult pretending to be a kid, redo it. Speed up audio 5-10% for energy. Use only royalty-free meme-style SFX.
